title: Settlement Basis for Relationship Bonus Owed on a Closed Statement Cycle
content:
The relationship bonus owed on a savings or money market account of Savings & Money Market Accounts for a closed statement cycle is settled on the bonus balance basis. The terms below are used in the sense given here.

**Bonus ledger basis.** The account's posted total of deposits and interest credited less the withdrawals posted to it, taken as no less than zero. This is the first of the two stages and looks to the account's posted totals.

**Bonus balance basis.** The bonus ledger basis is then further reduced by the withdrawals posted in the three calendar months ending on the review date. That further reduction is a second and separate stage, applied to the figure the first stage produced; the reduced figure, taken as no less than zero and capped at the tier's relationship bonus balance cap, is the bonus balance basis.

**Bonus review span.** The 31 days of the closed statement month.

**Bonus rate that applies.** The tier's relationship bonus annual percentage yield.

The relationship bonus owed for a closed statement cycle is settled only after the promotional interest due on that cycle's new money stands credited on the account.

**The relationship bonus owed.** The bonus balance basis multiplied by the bonus rate that applies, divided by 100, multiplied by the bonus review span in days and divided by the day count basis of 365, and that figure rounded half up to the cent.

**The bonus correction booked.** The relationship bonus already credited on the account in the one calendar month ending on the review date is deducted from the relationship bonus owed, and the bonus correction booked is the remainder, taken as no less than zero.

### Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a savings account whose posted totals are deposits of 60000.00 USD, interest credited of 400.00 USD and withdrawals of 25000.00 USD, of which 2000.00 USD were posted in the three calendar months ending on the review date. Take a hypothetical relationship bonus balance cap of 30000.00 USD, a hypothetical relationship bonus annual percentage yield of 0.40 percent, and a relationship bonus of 2.00 USD credited in the one calendar month ending on the review date.

The first stage gives a bonus ledger basis of 60000.00 USD plus 400.00 USD less 25000.00 USD, that is 35400.00 USD. The second stage reduces that figure by the 2000.00 USD of withdrawals posted in the three calendar months ending on the review date, giving 33400.00 USD, which the cap of 30000.00 USD then brings down to a bonus balance basis of 30000.00 USD.

The relationship bonus owed is 30000.00 USD multiplied by 0.40, divided by 100, multiplied by 31 and divided by 365, which is 10.1917 and rounds half up to 10.19 USD. The bonus correction booked is 10.19 USD less 2.00 USD, that is 8.19 USD.
